keypad.burstMode_desc1: $t(common:constant.feature.burstMode) is a faster and more focused Autoplay exclusive to $t(common:constant.brand.companyName) games.
keypad.burstMode_desc2: $t(common:constant.feature.burstMode) uses the same game engine and logic but the pace is much higher and therefore only the total win per game round is displayed.
keypad.burstMode_desc4: You can stop $t(common:constant.feature.burstMode) at any time and the result of the session will be displayed after the last game round is finished.
keypad.home_desc: Do you want to leave the game?
keypad.cashier_desc: Do you want to open the Cashier page?

help_menu.game_functions_desc: The table below lists the different buttons found in the game and describes their functions.
help_menu.spin_button_description: Click to start a game round at the current bet size.
help_menu.menu_description: Click to view the game settings menu and select game options.
help_menu.audio_playing_description: Click to disable the game sounds.
help_menu.audio_muted_description: Click to enable the game sounds.
help_menu.autoplay_description: Click to view the Autoplay menu and play the game automatically. Select the number of spins to Autoplay.
help_menu.bet_desktop_description: Click the + or – buttons to change the Bet size.
help_menu.bet_mobile_description: Click to change the Bet size.
help_menu.tab_home_description: Leave the game and go back to the Casino’s Lobby.
help_menu.tab_cashier_description: Leave the game and go to the Cashier in Casino’s Lobby.
help_menu.tab_autoplay_description: Select the number of spins to Autoplay and play the game automatically.
help_menu.tab_paytable_description: View the Paytable of the game.
help_menu.tab_settings_description: Modify the settings of the game.
help_menu.tab_leaderboard_description: View your own top wins in the game.
help_menu.quick_spin_enabled_description: Click to disable the quick spin.
help_menu.quick_spin_disabled_description: Click to enable the quick spin.
help_menu.super_quick_spin_enabled_description: Click to disable the super quick spin.
help_menu.super_quick_spin_disabled_description: Click to enable the super quick spin.

paytable.fastTrack_desc1: $t(common:constant.feature.fastTrack) gains direct access to the game's features.
paytable.fastTrack_desc2: $t(common:constant.feature.fastTrack) features can only be activated in the base game.
paytable.fastTrack_desc3: All game rules apply for $t(common:constant.feature.fastTrack) features.
paytable.fastTrack_desc4: When a $t(common:constant.feature.fastTrack) option is activated, each spin will have a fixed cost based on your current bet level and the selected feature.
paytable.fastTrack_desc5: The cost is charged per spin while $t(common:constant.feature.fastTrack) is active.
paytable.fastTrack_desc6: $t(common:constant.feature.fastTrack) will remain active until you disable it by clicking the feature icon.
paytable.fastTrack_feature_desc: Guarantees a game round triggering {{feature}} at the cost of {{betMultiplier}}x the selected bet.
paytable.rulesBetLevel_desc: The bet level cannot be changed during a game round.
paytable.rulesBets_desc: Bets are made in the casino currency and there are {{betLevelsAmount}} bet levels.
paytable.rulesCasinoCurrency_desc: All wins are displayed and paid in the casino currency in accordance with the paytable.
paytable.rulesHighestComboPaid_desc: Only the highest win combination per bet line is paid.
paytable.rulesInterruptedGameRound_desc: If a game round is interrupted, all information and bets will be displayed when the game is relaunched.
paytable.rulesEffectsAndAnimations_desc: Effects and animations are for display purposes only and has no effect on triggering wins.
paytable.rulesMalfunction: Malfunction voids all plays and pays.
paytable.rulesOperatorSpecificDetails_desc: Please see operator specific terms and conditions for details.
paytable.rulesRNGCertification_desc: The Random Number Generator (RNG) used by the $t(common:constant.brand.companyName) games has been certiﬁed by $t(common:constant.brand.certificationProvider) to comply with relevant standards.
paytable.rulesRTP_desc: The theoretical pay-out (RTP) is $t(game:constant.game.rtp)% and maximum win is $t(game:constant.game.maxWinMultiplier)x bet.
paytable.rulesRTPConfigurable_desc: The theoretical pay-out (RTP) is {{rtp}}% and maximum win is {{maxWin}}x bet.
paytable.rulesRTPWithTestRounds_desc: The theoretical pay-out (RTP) is {{rtp}}% and maximum win is {{maxWin}}x bet (based on {{testRoundsAmount}} test rounds).
paytable.rulesSamePlayerExperience_desc: All $t(common:constant.brand.companyName) games feature $t(common:constant.brand.trueReels) and $t(common:constant.brand.fixedRTP) which warrants that the player experience is the same across all operators and regardless if playing for fun or for real money.
paytable.rulesStandardSlot_desc: $t(game:constant.game.name) is a $t(game:constant.game.reelAmount) reel, $t(game:constant.game.rowAmount) row slot with $t(game:constant.game.betLineAmount) bet lines. All $t(game:constant.game.betLineAmount) bet lines are always played.
paytable.rulesSymbolMultipleWinCombo_desc: A symbol can be used in multiple winning combinations.
paytable.rulesWinsForfeited_desc: Wins from interrupted game rounds may be forfeited if they are not claimed within a certain period.
paytable.rulesWinsForfeitedSweden_desc: Wins from interrupted game rounds will be forfeited if they are not claimed within 90 days.
paytable.rulesWinsForfeitedPariplay_desc: All open sessions, which are not concluded by the player, plus any future transactions for those sessions, will be autocompleted after a certain time depending on the player's residence.
paytable.symbolsPay_desc: Symbol pays are multiplied with bet.
paytable.rulesWinFunctionality_leftToRight: Winning combinations are formed from left to right on adjacent reels, beginning from the leftmost reel.
paytable.rulesWinFunctionality_rightToLeft: Winning combinations are formed from right to left on adjacent reels, beginning from the rightmost reel.
paytable.rulesWinFunctionality_bothWays: Winning combinations are formed from left to right or right to left on adjacent reels, beginning from the leftmost or rightmost reel respectively.
paytable.rulesWinFunctionality_cluster: Winning combinations are formed in adjacent {{number}}+ cluster symbols.
paytable.rulesWinFunctionality_matchingSymbols: Winning combinations are formed by {{number}}+ identical symbols on the reels.
paytable.rulesMaxWinReached: If the total win during a game round reaches {{maxWin}}x, the game round will be ended and the won amount will be paid out.
paytable.winCombination_clusterScatter: Only the highest win is paid per winning combination.
paytable.winCombination_betline: Only the highest win is paid per bet line.
paytable.winCombination_betway: Only the highest win is paid per symbol.

dialog.userBlocked_desc2: Please see operator specific terms and conditions for details or contact customer support if you believe that you should not be blocked.

xtraBetPaytable.xtraBet_desc1: Activating $t(common:constant.feature.xtraBet) will raise your Base Bet by {{extraBetIncrease}}%, increasing the chance of triggering the $t(game:constant.game.freeSpins) $t(game:constant.game.bonus) by {{extraBetChance}} times.
xtraBetPaytable.xtraBet_desc2: $t(common:constant.feature.xtraBet) can be activated or deactivated by clicking or tapping on the toggle on the button.
xtraBetPaytable.xtraBet_desc3: When $t(common:constant.feature.xtraBet) is activated, wins are evaluated on the Base Bet amount and not the $t(common:constant.feature.xtraBet) amount.
xtraBetPaytable.xtraBet_desc4: $t(common:constant.feature.xtraBet) can only be activated/deactivated before a game round is initiated.
xtraBetPaytable.xtraBet_desc5: When the game is in autoplay, autoplay must be switched off to activate/deactivate the $t(common:constant.feature.xtraBet).
